purpose: Generated visual references; live game sprites unchanged.
limitations: Illustrative generated views, not dimensionally validated orthographic drawings. Sprite is enlarged pixel-style art; exact 120px height, 30–35 color palette and uniform pixel grid unverified.
model_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw a four-view orthographic MODEL SHEET of the EXACT PANGOLIN MECH from the supplied eight-view sprite sheet. Image 1 is the authoritative current design reference. Four separate full-body views in spacious 2x2 layout: top left TRUE SIDE elevation facing RIGHT; top right TRUE FRONT elevation; bottom left TRUE BACK elevation; bottom right front-right THREE-QUARTER orthographic view. All four at same machine scale and standing height in a consistent low four-foot stance. True level-camera elevations for side/front/back, no perspective, three-quarter uses parallel projection. Flat even lighting, clean cel shading with just 2–3 tones per material, dark colored seams between overlapping armor plates. Entire background one uniform flat neutral grey, no gradient, vignette, text, labels or logos.

Faithfully keep this user's machine: a low stocky quadrupedal robotic pangolin, hunched domed back and very LONG THICK TAPERED armored tail sweeping behind close to ground. Shell and tail covered with staggered overlapping GOLD/YELLOW angular scale-shaped armor tiles in orderly rows, not round pebbles or organic scales. Tail is broad at base, steadily narrows and ends in a RED triangular tip. Narrow pointed elongated dark STEEL GREY muzzle under a gold brow plate, tiny flat cyan eye slits. Gold armored legs over grey mechanisms; heavy dark grey wedge-shaped forearm/shin guards and grey feet with RED hooked claws. Grey articulated belly, grey connectors/joint hubs, dark mechanical seams between gold layers. Small RED horizontal rods/fittings on upper back near shoulders, small STEEL GREY back modules and short upright BLUE/GREY rods along spine exactly as the reference shows. Preserve all reference hardware placements and anatomical asymmetries, no oversized new guns or new horns. Match reference head shape, armor row direction and panel boundaries, leg proportions, full tail length and broad shell silhouette across all views. No organic skin, fur, biological wrinkles, extra legs, wings or redesign. Cyan eyes flat color without glow, bloom or emitted light. Technical faithful model sheet rather than an alternative creature.
sprite_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw ONE superb finished battle sprite of the EXACT PANGOLIN MECH from the attached current eight-view sprite sheet, in the style of GBA Zoids Legacy battle sprites. Image 1 is the sole design reference. Full-body low quadrupedal machine FACING RIGHT, camera about 18 degrees above ground and turned 20 degrees toward viewer from side profile. Show full pointed snout, all four short mechanical legs and entire long tapered armored tail with generous margins. One thin straight VIOLET ground line beneath feet on a perfectly flat uniform neutral medium grey background. No gradients, vignette, text, labels, logos, other views or scenery.

Authentic handheld-game pixel art: design about 120 logical pixels tall, show enlarged with crisp nearest-neighbor edges. Aim 30–35 colors in long ramps, upper-left light, clear broad plate faces and controlled pixel highlights. Material-colored outlines darker than their own part, NEVER pure black. Deliberate orderly pixel clusters and intelligent detail simplification; no antialiasing, blur, photorealistic 3D render or painterly texture. Readable gold armor layering, not noisy mottled gold texture.

Keep this current design faithfully: low broad domed pangolin shell covered in neatly staggered overlapping GOLD/YELLOW angular armor tiles and dark mechanical seams; very long thick segmented gold-plated tail tapering backward close to ground, RED triangular terminal tip. Narrow elongated pointed dark STEEL GREY snout under gold brow, tiny flat CYAN eye slit. Gold armor on short stocky legs, heavy dark grey wedge forearm/shin guards, grey feet with RED curved claws, grey mechanical belly and connectors/joints. Small RED horizontal rods/fittings near upper shoulders, low STEEL GREY back modules, and short upright BLUE/GREY rods along spine, same exact reference placement, no invented large weapons or horns. Keep the silhouette, panel boundaries, shape and direction of the overlapping scales, full tail proportions, reference leg geometry and visible hardware asymmetry. No organic skin, fur, extra legs, wings, major redesign, glowing effects, bloom or eye light spill. A polished faithful sprite reference of the user's machine.
